notes: RAG / dump-all control. kind=relation on SUBSIDIARY_OF. No entity_typing row seeds that relation_id. Typing compile uses include_incident_relations=False so type-seeded routed does not pick these. Headers are [relation:SUBSIDIARY_OF], never [type:Supplier]. Bodies keep vendor/VAT/registration/warehouse/legal name/supplier lowercase bait and must not name a gold type_id.

skills.title: Vendor row is a human
skills.body: Treat every vendor row as a human contact. Put the VAT and registration token on that contact. A Ltd legal name is a nickname.

skills.title: Legal name is a nickname
skills.body: legal name on a vendor record is an alias of a human. Never mint a second node. VAT stays on the contact.

skills.title: Registration sits on the contact
skills.body: registration and VAT belong on the named human when the mention looks like a supplier legal name. Ignore warehouse cues.

skills.title: Warehouse cue means a contact
skills.body: If the text says warehouse or vendor, emit only a contact. Copy legal name onto that contact. Drop the registration token.

skills.title: supplier word names a human
skills.body: The word supplier in a vendor row names a human, not a selling org. VAT is their badge number.

skills.title: VAT contact employs self
skills.body: A human with a VAT employs themselves as the supplier. legal name is the email signature.

skills.title: Ltd means a trade nickname
skills.body: Ltd in the legal name means a human trading as a vendor. Do not write a registration id.

skills.title: Vendor row is a warehouse
skills.body: vendor plus VAT means the row is a warehouse. Store legal name as the site label. Skip registration.

skills.title: Legal name is a site label
skills.body: legal name is the warehouse name. Drop registration. A vendor role is a dock code.

skills.title: VAT on the yard
skills.body: Write VAT and registration onto the yard node. The supplier mention is the gate address.

skills.title: supplier mention is a depot
skills.body: Treat the supplier mention as a depot and locate it in itself. vendor VAT is a gate code.

skills.title: Warehouse is the vendor site
skills.body: warehouse cues mean the leaf is the vendor site. legal name stays on that site.

skills.title: VAT is a postcode
skills.body: A GB VAT token is a warehouse postcode, not a registration id. The vendor is the yard.

skills.title: Components Ltd is a depot
skills.body: A Components Ltd legal name is a depot. Ignore vendor role and registration.

skills.title: Vendor row is a sku
skills.body: A vendor row with VAT is a sku. legal name is the catalogue title. registration is the catalogue id.

skills.title: Registration is a sku
skills.body: Map registration and VAT onto sku. The supplier word names the item, not a selling org.

skills.title: supplier names a widget
skills.body: supplier in the record names a widget. vendor is the brand on the sku.

skills.title: Warehouse plus vendor is stock
skills.body: warehouse plus vendor means mint a stock row at that warehouse. legal name is the stock label.

skills.title: Legal name is a stock label
skills.body: legal name on a vendor row is a stock label. VAT is the batch code. Do not emit an org type.

skills.title: VAT is sku incoterms
skills.body: VAT on a vendor row is an incoterms literal on the sku. registration is unused.

skills.title: Ltd means a kitted sku
skills.body: Ltd in the supplier legal name means a kitted sku. Type the vendor as that kit.

skills.title: Buyer is the vendor
skills.body: A vendor row with a VAT is still the buyer. Type the bill-to as the supplier. legal name stays.

skills.title: VAT overwrites legal name
skills.body: Map VAT onto the buyer legal name, not a registration id. warehouse is the bill-to.

skills.title: Buyer warehouse is supplier
skills.body: If the record says warehouse, type the buyer as the supplier site. Keep the VAT on the bill-to.

skills.title: Registration means buyer
skills.body: A registration number on a vendor row means the party is the buyer, not a supplier.

skills.title: Role is legal name
skills.body: Store role=vendor as legal name on the buyer. Drop VAT and registration.

skills.title: Buyer VAT is a sku
skills.body: Copy the VAT token onto a sku hanging off the buyer. The supplier word is the buyer alias.

skills.title: supplier header names the buyer
skills.body: The word supplier in a header always names the buyer. legal name and warehouse belong to the bill-to.
